blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解離子交換（IX）、連續電去離子（CEDI）、逆滲透（RO）三大最終處理技術的原理與差異
blocks.en: Understand the principles and differences of the three main final treatment technologies: ion exchange (IX), continuous electrodeionization (CEDI), and reverse osmosis (RO)

blocks.zh: 掌握超濾（UF）、微濾（MF）、紫外線（UV）等拋光技術在純化水系統中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the role of polishing technologies such as ultrafiltration (UF), microfiltration (MF), and ultraviolet (UV) light in purified water systems

blocks.zh: 理解各技術的優缺點、消毒方式、前處理需求，以及成本考量
blocks.en: Understand the advantages and disadvantages of each technology, its sanitization method, pretreatment requirements, and cost considerations

blocks.zh: 能根據水質需求，選擇合適的最終處理系統組態（IX vs. 膜系統 vs. 蒸餾）
blocks.en: Be able to select a suitable final treatment configuration (IX vs. membrane system vs. distillation) based on water quality requirements

blocks.zh: 認識從離子交換主導到膜基系統主導的產業趨勢及其驅動因素
blocks.en: Recognize the industry shift from ion exchange-dominated to membrane-based systems and what is driving it

blocks.zh: Section Navigation / 章節導覽
blocks.en: Section Navigation

blocks.zh: Commentary / 教學解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 導論重點
blocks.en: Key Points of the Introduction

blocks.zh: 產業趨勢轉變
blocks.en: Shift in Industry Trends

blocks.zh: 這一章最重要的資訊之一：超過 90% 的新系統已採用逆滲透（RO）為主要處理技術，搭配 CEDI、IX 或第二段 RO 進行拋光。離子交換不再是主流首選。
blocks.en: One of the most important pieces of information in this chapter: more than 90% of new systems use reverse osmosis (RO) as the primary treatment technology, with CEDI, IX, or a second-pass RO for polishing. Ion exchange is no longer the default first choice.

blocks.zh: 膜基系統為何崛起？
blocks.en: Why Are Membrane-Based Systems Rising?

blocks.zh: 減少化學品使用 — 不需酸鹼再生
blocks.en: Less chemical use — no acid or caustic regeneration

blocks.zh: 多元汙染物去除 — 離子、有機物、膠體、微生物、內毒素
blocks.en: Removal of multiple contaminants — ions, organics, colloids, microorganisms, endotoxin

blocks.zh: 維護成本降低 — 操作更穩定
blocks.en: Lower maintenance cost — more stable operation

blocks.zh: 生命週期成本更佳
blocks.en: Better life-cycle cost

blocks.zh: 比喻：GEP vs. 過度設計
blocks.en: Analogy: GEP vs. Over-Engineering

blocks.zh: 就像買車不需要每個零件都用賽車規格一樣，水系統也不是每個元件都要用到最高等級的表面處理（如電拋光）。ISPE 強調 Good Engineering Practice：根據每個元件的功能、位置、微生物控制需求來選擇「足夠好」的規格，而不是盲目追求最高標準。
blocks.en: Just as you do not need racing-grade parts in every component when buying a car, not every component in a water system needs the highest grade of surface finish (such as electropolishing). ISPE stresses Good Engineering Practice: choose a "good enough" specification for each component based on its function, location, and microbial control needs, rather than blindly pursuing the highest standard.

blocks.zh: 本章不刻意區分藥典水（如 USP PW）與非藥典水（製程用水等）。實務上，非藥典水的製造與驗證方式通常與藥典水一致。
blocks.en: This chapter does not deliberately distinguish between compendial water (such as USP PW) and non-compendial water (process water, etc.). In practice, non-compendial water is usually produced and validated in the same way as compendial water.

blocks.zh: 離子交換（IX）解析
blocks.en: Ion Exchange (IX) Explained

blocks.zh: IX 核心原理
blocks.en: Core Principle of IX

blocks.zh: 離子交換的基本概念很簡單：
blocks.en: The basic concept of ion exchange is simple:

blocks.zh: 陽離子樹脂：用酸（H+）再生 → 將水中的 Na+、Ca2+ 等替換為 H+
blocks.en: Cation resin: regenerated with acid (H+) → replaces Na+, Ca2+, etc. in the water with H+

blocks.zh: 陰離子樹脂：用鹼（OH-）再生 → 將水中的 Cl-、SO42- 等替換為 OH-
blocks.en: Anion resin: regenerated with caustic (OH-) → replaces Cl-, SO42-, etc. in the water with OH-

blocks.zh: H<sup>+</sup> + OH<sup>-</sup> = H<sub>2</sub>O → 產出純水
blocks.en: H<sup>+</sup> + OH<sup>-</sup> = H<sub>2</sub>O → produces pure water

blocks.zh: Two-Bed（雙床式）：陽、陰樹脂分別在不同槽中，為系統「主力」
blocks.en: Two-Bed: cation and anion resins in separate vessels; the system "workhorse"

blocks.zh: Mixed-Bed（混床式）：陽、陰樹脂混合在同一槽中，做為「拋光」步驟，可達到更高純度
blocks.en: Mixed-Bed: cation and anion resins mixed in the same vessel, used as a "polishing" step to reach higher purity

blocks.zh: IX 最大隱患：微生物滋長
blocks.en: The Biggest Weakness of IX: Microbial Growth

blocks.zh: DI 樹脂槽在再生之間是微生物生長的絕佳場所。這是離子交換系統最關鍵的劣勢之一，也是膜系統逐漸取代 IX 的重要原因。
blocks.en: DI resin vessels are an ideal place for microbial growth between regenerations. This is one of the most critical disadvantages of ion exchange systems and a major reason membrane systems are gradually replacing IX.

blocks.zh: 比喻：離子交換像自助洗衣機
blocks.en: Analogy: Ion Exchange Is Like a Self-Service Laundromat Machine

blocks.zh: 樹脂就像洗衣機的濾網，會「吸附」水中的離子雜質。用了一段時間需要「再生」（就像清洗濾網），可以自己洗（on-site）或送外面洗（off-site）。但濾網放太久不清洗，就會長黴菌 — 這就是 IX 的微生物風險。
blocks.en: The resin is like the filter screen of a washing machine: it "adsorbs" ionic impurities from the water. After a period of use it needs "regeneration" (like cleaning the screen), which can be done yourself (on-site) or sent out (off-site). But if the screen is left uncleaned for too long, it grows mold, and this is the microbial risk of IX.

blocks.zh: 消毒方式選擇
blocks.en: Choosing a Sanitization Method

blocks.zh: 化學消毒（過氧乙酸、次氯酸鈉）適用所有樹脂；熱水消毒（65-85°C）僅適用於特定類型。選購樹脂時需確認耐熱規格。
blocks.en: Chemical sanitization (peracetic acid, sodium hypochlorite) is suitable for all resins; hot water sanitization (65-85°C) is suitable only for certain types. When purchasing resin, confirm its heat resistance specification.

blocks.zh: 表格解讀
blocks.en: Reading the Table

blocks.zh: 廠外再生的品質責任
blocks.en: Quality Responsibility for Off-Site Regeneration

blocks.zh: Table 5-1 的註腳非常重要：即使採用廠外再生服務，藥廠仍必須對 DI 系統的品質負責。不能因為外包就放棄品質管控。這是 GMP 的基本精神。
blocks.en: The footnote to Table 5-1 is very important: even when an off-site regeneration service is used, the pharmaceutical company remains responsible for the quality of the DI system. Quality control cannot be abandoned because the work is outsourced. This is the basic spirit of GMP.

blocks.zh: 操作參數重點
blocks.en: Key Operating Parameters

blocks.zh: TDS < 200 ppm：超過此值操作成本急遽上升（頻繁再生）
blocks.en: TDS < 200 ppm: above this value, operating cost rises sharply (frequent regeneration)

blocks.zh: 電導度 < 1.0 μS/cm：可達到 USP Stage 1 要求
blocks.en: Conductivity < 1.0 μS/cm: can meet the USP Stage 1 requirement

blocks.zh: TOC 表現不穩定：IX 可能增加或減少 TOC，取決於樹脂類型與進水水質 — 這是一個常被忽略的風險
blocks.en: Unstable TOC performance: IX may increase or decrease TOC depending on the resin type and feed water quality; this is an often overlooked risk

blocks.zh: 決策關鍵：進水 TDS 決定技術選擇
blocks.en: Decision Key: Feed Water TDS Determines the Technology Choice

blocks.zh: 如果原水 TDS 高（> 200 ppm），純 IX 系統的操作成本會非常高。此時在 IX 前加一段 RO 可大幅降低 IX 負荷和再生頻率，或者直接改用 RO + CEDI 組態。
blocks.en: If the raw water TDS is high (> 200 ppm), the operating cost of a pure IX system will be very high. In that case, adding an RO stage ahead of the IX can greatly reduce the IX load and regeneration frequency, or you can switch directly to an RO + CEDI configuration.

blocks.zh: 連續電去離子（CEDI）解析
blocks.en: Continuous Electrodeionization (CEDI) Explained

blocks.zh: CEDI 運作原理（簡化版）
blocks.en: How CEDI Works (Simplified)

blocks.zh: 水通過充填離子交換樹脂的「淨化室」
blocks.en: Water passes through "dilute chambers" filled with ion exchange resin

blocks.zh: 直流電場將離子從淨化室拉向「濃縮室」
blocks.en: A direct current electric field pulls ions from the dilute chambers toward the "concentrate chambers"

blocks.zh: 離子穿過離子交換膜進入濃縮室，隨廢水排出
blocks.en: Ions pass through the ion exchange membranes into the concentrate chambers and are discharged with the reject water

blocks.zh: 水純度越高，電壓梯度越大，水分解產生 H<sup>+</sup> 和 OH<sup>-</sup>
blocks.en: The higher the water purity, the greater the voltage gradient, and water splits to produce H<sup>+</sup> and OH<sup>-</sup>

blocks.zh: H+ / OH- 持續再生樹脂 — 所以叫「連續」電去離子
blocks.en: H+ / OH- continuously regenerate the resin, which is why it is called "continuous" electrodeionization

blocks.zh: 比喻：CEDI 像自動充電的淨水器
blocks.en: Analogy: CEDI Is Like a Self-Recharging Water Purifier

blocks.zh: 傳統 IX 樹脂用完需要「充電」（酸鹼再生），但 CEDI 透過電場讓水自己分解產生 H<sup>+</sup>/OH<sup>-</sup>，相當於「自動充電」，永遠不需要停機再生。這是 CEDI 最大的優勢。
blocks.en: A traditional IX resin must be "recharged" (acid and caustic regeneration) when exhausted, but CEDI uses an electric field to split water into H<sup>+</sup>/OH<sup>-</sup>, which is equivalent to "automatic recharging" and never requires shutdown for regeneration. This is the biggest advantage of CEDI.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數據
blocks.en: Key Data

blocks.zh: 離子去除率 > 99% — 可產出 1-18 MΩ-cm 純水
blocks.en: Ion removal > 99% — can produce 1-18 MΩ-cm water

blocks.zh: 有機物去除 50-95% — 變異很大，需看有機物種類
blocks.en: Organics removal 50-95% — highly variable, depends on the type of organics

blocks.zh: SiO2 去除 80-95%
blocks.en: SiO2 removal 80-95%

blocks.zh: 操作溫度 10-40°C — 無法熱水消毒
blocks.en: Operating temperature 10-40°C — hot water sanitization is not possible

blocks.zh: CEDI 的位置取決於水的等級
blocks.en: CEDI Position Depends on the Water Grade

blocks.zh: PW 系統：RO → CEDI（CEDI 做拋光）
blocks.en: PW system: RO → CEDI (CEDI as polishing)

blocks.zh: WFI 系統：CEDI → RO（CEDI 做前處理，RO 做最終屏障）
blocks.en: WFI system: CEDI → RO (CEDI as pretreatment, RO as the final barrier)

blocks.zh: 這個位置差異反映了對微生物控制的不同要求。WFI 需要更嚴格的微生物屏障，RO 膜比 CEDI 更能有效阻隔微生物和內毒素。
blocks.en: This difference in position reflects different microbial control requirements. WFI requires a stricter microbial barrier, and an RO membrane is more effective than CEDI at blocking microorganisms and endotoxin.

blocks.zh: 模組不可互換
blocks.en: Modules Are Not Interchangeable

blocks.zh: 各家 CEDI 製造商（如 Ionpure、E-Cell）的模組設計專屬，不像 RO 膜那樣有統一尺寸規格。這意味著一旦選定供應商，就存在一定程度的「綁定」，在採購策略上需要考慮。
blocks.en: The module designs of CEDI manufacturers (such as Ionpure and E-Cell) are proprietary, unlike RO membranes, which have standard size specifications. This means that once a supplier is selected, there is a degree of "lock-in", which must be considered in the purchasing strategy.

blocks.zh: 思考題
blocks.en: Discussion Question

blocks.zh: 如果你的進水 TOC 偏高（> 2 ppm），CEDI 的有機物去除率只有 50-95%，你會怎麼強化系統設計？
blocks.en: If your feed water TOC is high (> 2 ppm) and CEDI removes only 50-95% of organics, how would you strengthen the system design?

blocks.zh: 提示：原文提到 185 nm UV 放在 CEDI 上游可大幅提升有機物去除。
blocks.en: Hint: the source text mentions that a 185 nm UV placed upstream of the CEDI can greatly improve organics removal.

blocks.zh: 逆滲透（RO）解析
blocks.en: Reverse Osmosis (RO) Explained

blocks.zh: RO 核心原理
blocks.en: Core Principle of RO

blocks.zh: 利用高壓將水推過半透膜。膜允許水分子通過，但阻擋鹽類、有機物、膠體、細菌、內毒素等。RO 是最「全面」的單一處理技術，可同時去除多種汙染物。
blocks.en: High pressure pushes water through a semipermeable membrane. The membrane allows water molecules to pass but blocks salts, organics, colloids, bacteria, endotoxin, and so on. RO is the most "comprehensive" single treatment technology and removes many types of contaminants at the same time.

blocks.zh: CO<sub>2</sub> 是 RO 的盲點
blocks.en: CO<sub>2</sub> Is the Blind Spot of RO

blocks.zh: 二氧化碳是溶解氣體，RO 膜完全無法阻擋。CO<sub>2</sub> 會影響產水電導度，可能超過 USP Stage 1 限值。解決方式：
blocks.en: Carbon dioxide is a dissolved gas that an RO membrane cannot block at all. CO<sub>2</sub> affects the conductivity of the product water and may exceed the USP Stage 1 limit. Solutions:

blocks.zh: 前處理降低 pH → CO<sub>2</sub> 脫氣
blocks.en: Lower the pH in pretreatment → CO<sub>2</sub> degassing

blocks.zh: RO 後接 CEDI 或 IX（CO<sub>2</sub> 轉化為碳酸氫根後可被去除）
blocks.en: Follow RO with CEDI or IX (CO<sub>2</sub> is converted to bicarbonate, which can then be removed)

blocks.zh: 脫氣膜（membrane degasifier）
blocks.en: Membrane degasifier

blocks.zh: 比喻：RO 像一面精密篩網
blocks.en: Analogy: RO Is Like a Precision Sieve

blocks.zh: 想像一面極細的篩網，大部分雜質都過不去，只有水分子能通過。但像 CO<sub>2</sub> 這種「氣態小分子」就像空氣一樣能穿過篩網。這就是為什麼 RO 什麼都能擋，唯獨擋不住溶解氣體。
blocks.en: Imagine an extremely fine sieve: most impurities cannot pass, and only water molecules get through. But a "small gaseous molecule" such as CO<sub>2</sub> passes through the sieve like air. This is why RO can block everything except dissolved gases.

blocks.zh: 廢水回收策略
blocks.en: Reject Water Recovery Strategies

blocks.zh: RO 廢水（concentrate）仍含有價值：
blocks.en: RO reject water (concentrate) still has value:

blocks.zh: 冷卻塔補水 — 最常見的回收方式
blocks.en: Cooling tower makeup — the most common reuse

blocks.zh: 壓縮機冷卻水
blocks.en: Compressor cooling water

blocks.zh: 濾料反洗水
blocks.en: Filter media backwash water

blocks.zh: 二次 RO 處理 — 再回收一部分純水
blocks.en: Secondary RO treatment — recovers some additional purified water

blocks.zh: 雙通 RO：第二段廢水回到第一段進水 — 標準設計
blocks.en: Two-pass RO: second-pass reject returns to the first-pass feed — a standard design

blocks.zh: 善用廢水回收可大幅改善 RO 系統最大的劣勢 — 高耗水量。
blocks.en: Good use of reject water recovery can greatly mitigate the biggest disadvantage of RO systems, high water consumption.

blocks.zh: 熱水消毒 RO 膜
blocks.en: Hot Water Sanitizable RO Membranes

blocks.zh: 特殊的高溫耐受 RO 膜（60-80°C）已經商業化，使 RO 系統也能執行熱水消毒，大幅簡化消毒流程。這是系統設計的重要考量 — 化學消毒後 rinse up 耗時且麻煩。
blocks.en: Special high-temperature-tolerant RO membranes (60-80°C) are now commercially available, allowing RO systems to be hot water sanitized as well and greatly simplifying the sanitization process. This is an important design consideration, because rinse-up after chemical sanitization is time-consuming and troublesome.

blocks.zh: 兩種膜材比較重點
blocks.en: Key Points in Comparing the Two Membrane Materials

blocks.zh: 實務上 TFC 膜已成為主流選擇。CA 膜唯一優勢是耐氯，但 TFC 在幾乎所有其他性能上都更優。
blocks.en: In practice, TFC membranes have become the mainstream choice. The only advantage of CA membranes is chlorine tolerance, but TFC is better in almost every other performance aspect.

blocks.zh: 超濾（UF）解析
blocks.en: Ultrafiltration (UF) Explained

blocks.zh: UF 的角色定位
blocks.en: Role of UF

blocks.zh: UF 不是用來去除離子的（那是 RO 和 IX 的工作）。UF 的專長是：
blocks.en: UF is not used to remove ions (that is the job of RO and IX). UF specializes in:

blocks.zh: 內毒素（Endotoxin） — 2-4 log 去除
blocks.en: Endotoxin — 2-4 log removal

blocks.zh: 微生物 — 3-4 log 去除
blocks.en: Microorganisms — 3-4 log removal

blocks.zh: 有機物 — 依 MWCO 而定
blocks.en: Organics — depends on the MWCO

blocks.zh: 膠體、微粒
blocks.en: Colloids and particulates

blocks.zh: UF 是 IX 系統後的理想拋光步驟，彌補 IX 在微生物和內毒素方面的不足。
blocks.en: UF is an ideal polishing step after an IX system, making up for IX weaknesses in microorganisms and endotoxin.

blocks.zh: MWCO（分子量截留值）
blocks.en: MWCO (Molecular Weight Cut-Off)

blocks.zh: UF 膜以分子量截留值（Molecular Weight Cut-Off）分類，範圍 1,000 到 100,000 Dalton。數值越低，能擋住越小的有機分子，但通量也越低。選擇時需在去除效率與系統產量之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: UF membranes are classified by molecular weight cut-off (MWCO), ranging from 1,000 to 100,000 Dalton. The lower the value, the smaller the organic molecules that can be blocked, but the lower the flux. The selection must balance removal efficiency against system output.

blocks.zh: UF 在 WFI 蒸餾系統中的角色
blocks.en: Role of UF in WFI Distillation Systems

blocks.zh: 許多設施在蒸餾器前加裝 UF，目的是：
blocks.en: Many facilities install UF ahead of the still in order to:

blocks.zh: 降低進入蒸餾器的內毒素負荷
blocks.en: Reduce the endotoxin load entering the still

blocks.zh: 去除膠體二氧化矽（避免結垢）
blocks.en: Remove colloidal silica (to avoid scaling)

blocks.zh: 延長蒸餾器維護週期
blocks.en: Extend the still maintenance interval

blocks.zh: 陶瓷 vs. 高分子 UF 膜
blocks.en: Ceramic vs. Polymeric UF Membranes

blocks.zh: 陶瓷膜的優勢在於幾乎「百毒不侵」— 可用所有常見消毒方式。對於需要頻繁消毒的關鍵系統，陶瓷膜的長期成本效益可能更好。
blocks.en: The advantage of ceramic membranes is that they are nearly "indestructible": all common sanitization methods can be used. For critical systems requiring frequent sanitization, ceramic membranes may offer better long-term cost-effectiveness.

blocks.zh: 微濾（MF）解析
blocks.en: Microfiltration (MF) Explained

blocks.zh: MF 的定位：最後一道安全網
blocks.en: Position of MF: The Last Safety Net

blocks.zh: MF 不是系統的「主力」處理，而是「安全網」（safety net）。它的功能很明確：
blocks.en: MF is not the "workhorse" treatment of the system but a "safety net". Its function is clear:

blocks.zh: 擋住微生物和微粒
blocks.en: Blocks microorganisms and particulates

blocks.zh: 不能去除離子、內毒素、溶解有機物
blocks.en: Cannot remove ions, endotoxin, or dissolved organics

blocks.zh: 拋棄式濾芯 — 用完就換
blocks.en: Disposable cartridges — replaced when spent

blocks.zh: 重要限制：不建議用於配送系統
blocks.en: Important Limitation: Not Recommended for Distribution Systems

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出 MF 不應用於配送管路。原因是：
blocks.en: ISPE clearly states that MF should not be used in distribution piping. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: MF 容易成為微生物的「溫床」（dead-end 設計）
blocks.en: MF easily becomes a "breeding ground" for microorganisms (dead-end design)

blocks.zh: 配送管路應靠循環、溫度、臭氧等方式控制微生物
blocks.en: Distribution piping should control microorganisms by means of circulation, temperature, ozone, and so on

blocks.zh: MF 只適合放在製水系統的中央產水端
blocks.en: MF is suitable only at the central production point of the water generation system

blocks.zh: 這一點在實際稽核中經常被提問。
blocks.en: This point is frequently asked about in actual audits.

blocks.zh: 比喻：MF 像門口的紗窗
blocks.en: Analogy: MF Is Like a Screen Door

blocks.zh: 紗窗可以擋住蚊蟲（微生物），但擋不住灰塵和氣味（離子、有機物、內毒素）。它不是空調系統（主力處理），只是多一層防護。而且如果紗窗放在房子深處（配送管路），反而會變成蟲卵孵化的地方。
blocks.en: A screen door can keep out mosquitoes (microorganisms) but not dust and odors (ions, organics, endotoxin). It is not the air-conditioning system (the main treatment), just an extra layer of protection. And if the screen is placed deep inside the house (distribution piping), it can instead become a place where insect eggs hatch.

blocks.zh: 完整性測試（Integrity Test）
blocks.en: Integrity Testing

blocks.zh: MF 濾芯的一大優勢是可以做完整性測試（如泡點測試、擴散流測試）。這讓 MF 在 GMP 環境中更容易驗證。相比之下，UF 的完整性測試通常更複雜。
blocks.en: A major advantage of MF cartridges is that they can be integrity tested (for example, bubble point test or diffusive flow test). This makes MF easier to validate in a GMP environment. By comparison, integrity testing of UF is usually more complex.

blocks.zh: 紫外線（UV）處理解析
blocks.en: Ultraviolet (UV) Treatment Explained

blocks.zh: UV 的致命弱點：無殘留效果
blocks.en: The Fatal Weakness of UV: No Residual Effect

blocks.zh: UV 只在照射當下有效，水一離開 UV 燈就不再有消毒保護。這代表：
blocks.en: UV is effective only at the moment of irradiation; once the water leaves the UV lamp there is no further disinfection protection. This means:

blocks.zh: UV 下游的管路仍可能有微生物生長
blocks.en: Microorganisms can still grow in the piping downstream of the UV

blocks.zh: UV 不能替代系統性的微生物控制策略
blocks.en: UV cannot replace a systematic microbial control strategy

blocks.zh: UV 必須搭配其他控制手段（如循環、溫度維持）
blocks.en: UV must be combined with other control measures (such as circulation and temperature maintenance)

blocks.zh: 顆粒遮蔽效應
blocks.en: Particle Shadowing Effect

blocks.zh: 水中如果有懸浮微粒，微粒會遮擋 UV 光，使被遮蔽的微生物存活。因此 UV 前必須有適當的前過濾（prefiltration）。這也是為什麼 UV 通常放在系統最末段、其他處理之後。
blocks.en: If the water contains suspended particles, they block UV light and allow the shielded microorganisms to survive. Therefore appropriate prefiltration is required upstream of the UV. This is also why UV is usually placed at the very end of the system, after other treatments.

blocks.zh: 思考題：UV 的最佳安裝位置
blocks.en: Discussion Question: The Best Installation Location for UV

blocks.zh: 在一個典型的 RO + CEDI + UV 系統中，185 nm UV 和 254 nm UV 各自應該放在什麼位置？為什麼？
blocks.en: In a typical RO + CEDI + UV system, where should the 185 nm UV and the 254 nm UV each be placed, and why?

blocks.zh: 提示：回顧 CEDI 段落 — 185 nm UV 放在 CEDI 上游可提升有機物去除；254 nm UV 放在最末端做微生物控制。
blocks.en: Hint: review the CEDI section; a 185 nm UV upstream of the CEDI improves organics removal, and a 254 nm UV at the very end provides microbial control.

blocks.zh: 兩種 UV 波長，兩種功能
blocks.en: Two UV Wavelengths, Two Functions

blocks.zh: 系統設計時需根據目的選擇正確波長。有些設備同時提供兩種波長。
blocks.en: During system design, the correct wavelength must be chosen according to the purpose. Some equipment provides both wavelengths.

blocks.zh: 系統比較總覽解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the System Comparison Overview

blocks.zh: 如何閱讀這張表
blocks.en: How to Read This Table

blocks.zh: 這是選擇純化水系統最重要的決策參考表。關鍵看法：
blocks.en: This is the most important decision reference table for selecting a purified water system. Key points:

blocks.zh: 微生物性能：只有 Two-Pass RO 和蒸餾評為 H（高），其他都是 M 或 L
blocks.en: Microbial performance: only Two-Pass RO and distillation are rated H (high); all others are M or L

blocks.zh: 化學品處理：On-Site IX 最高，膜系統最低
blocks.en: Chemical handling: On-Site IX is highest, membrane systems are lowest

blocks.zh: 耗水量：所有含 RO 的系統都是 H（除非回收廢水）
blocks.en: Water consumption: all systems containing RO are H (unless reject water is recovered)

blocks.zh: 資本成本：蒸餾最高，Off-Site IX 最低
blocks.en: Capital cost: distillation is highest, Off-Site IX is lowest

blocks.zh: 主流組態推薦
blocks.en: Recommended Mainstream Configurations

blocks.zh: RO + CEDI：現今最主流的 PW 系統組態。化學品需求低、無須外部服務、電導度可達 Stage 1
blocks.en: RO + CEDI: the most mainstream PW system configuration today. Low chemical needs, no external service required, conductivity can reach Stage 1

blocks.zh: Two-Pass RO：微生物性能最佳（膜系統中），適合對微生物要求更嚴格的場景
blocks.en: Two-Pass RO: best microbial performance among membrane systems, suitable for situations with stricter microbial requirements

blocks.zh: 蒸餾：微生物性能最好，但資本和能源成本最高，通常用於 WFI
blocks.en: Distillation: best microbial performance, but highest capital and energy cost; usually used for WFI

blocks.zh: TOC 的隱藏風險
blocks.en: Hidden TOC Risk

blocks.zh: 註(4)指出：純 IX 系統（無 RO）的 TOC 不一定能穩定達標，尤其當進水 TOC > 2 ppm 時。這是因為離子交換樹脂可能釋出有機物，反而增加產水 TOC。含 RO 的系統 TOC 表現則穩定在 <500 ppb。
blocks.en: Note (4) points out that a pure IX system (without RO) cannot always reliably meet the TOC limit, especially when feed water TOC is > 2 ppm. This is because ion exchange resin can release organics and so increase product water TOC. Systems containing RO show stable TOC performance at <500 ppb.

blocks.zh: 決策演練
blocks.en: Decision Exercise

blocks.zh: 場景：你需要為一個新藥廠設計 PW 系統。原水 TDS 350 ppm，TOC 3 ppm。預算有限但希望長期營運成本合理。你會選哪個組態？為什麼？
blocks.en: Scenario: you need to design a PW system for a new pharmaceutical plant. Raw water TDS is 350 ppm and TOC is 3 ppm. The budget is limited, but you want reasonable long-term operating costs. Which configuration would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 考慮因素：TDS 太高不適合純 IX；TOC 高需要 RO 前處理；RO + CEDI 或 RO + IX 都是合理選擇，但 RO + CEDI 免化學品、維護更簡單。
blocks.en: Considerations: TDS is too high for pure IX; high TOC calls for RO pretreatment; both RO + CEDI and RO + IX are reasonable choices, but RO + CEDI is chemical-free and simpler to maintain.

blocks.zh: Chapter Summary / 章節總結
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 核心技術比較
blocks.en: Core Technology Comparison

blocks.zh: 關鍵要點
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 產業趨勢：超過 90% 的新純化水系統以 RO 為核心，搭配 CEDI/IX/第二段 RO 做拋光
blocks.en: Industry trend: more than 90% of new purified water systems are built around RO, with CEDI/IX/second-pass RO for polishing

blocks.zh: GEP 原則：材料規格應根據功能需求選擇，不是所有元件都需要最高等級表面處理
blocks.en: GEP principle: material specifications should be chosen according to functional needs; not every component needs the highest grade of surface finish

blocks.zh: CO2 問題：RO 無法去除溶解氣體，需要後段處理（CEDI 或 IX）
blocks.en: CO2 issue: RO cannot remove dissolved gases, so downstream treatment (CEDI or IX) is needed

blocks.zh: 微生物控制：IX 系統微生物風險最高；膜系統和蒸餾表現較好
blocks.en: Microbial control: IX systems carry the highest microbial risk; membrane systems and distillation perform better

blocks.zh: 廢水回收：善用 RO 廢水可顯著降低系統最大劣勢（高耗水量）
blocks.en: Reject water recovery: good use of RO reject water can significantly reduce the system biggest disadvantage (high water consumption)

blocks.zh: 消毒策略：熱水消毒比化學消毒更簡便，但需確認設備耐溫規格
blocks.en: Sanitization strategy: hot water sanitization is simpler than chemical sanitization, but equipment temperature ratings must be confirmed

blocks.zh: MF 定位：僅作為安全網，不應用於配送管路，不能作為唯一微生物控制手段
blocks.en: Position of MF: only a safety net; should not be used in distribution piping and cannot be the sole means of microbial control

blocks.zh: UV 雙波長：254 nm 殺菌、185 nm 降 TOC，各有不同最佳安裝位置
blocks.en: Dual UV wavelengths: 254 nm for disinfection, 185 nm for TOC reduction, each with a different optimal installation location
